itineraries.title: Durham Good Moon Saturday: Market, Free Matinee, Sylvan Esso
itineraries.theme: Farmers and craft markets, a free Good Moon lawn show, then Sylvan Esso at DPAC
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh via I-40 / NC-147; everything after the market is walkable around American Tobacco Campus
itineraries.cost_range: Free until the evening; Sylvan Esso ticket price not listed on the source (check Ticketmaster) plus about $40–$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: Durham is hosting the Good Moon Festival. Start at the Saturday farmers and craft markets in Durham Central Park, catch the free MJ Lenderman matinee on the American Tobacco Campus lawn, and end at DPAC for Sylvan Esso with Silvana Estrada.

morning.title: Durham Farmers' Market
morning.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC
morning.notes: Saturday market, 8 AM–noon at the Durham Central Park pavilion.

morning.title: Durham Craft Market
morning.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC
morning.notes: Craft vendors next to the farmers market, same hours.

afternoon.title: Good Moon Pres. FREE MATINEE feat. MJ Lenderman, Rodrigo Amarante and more
afternoon.location: American Tobacco Campus, 300 Blackwell Street #104, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: Free Good Moon matinee on the ATC lawn, 3–6 PM. Eventbrite RSVP listed.

evening.title: Good Moon Festival: Sylvan Esso with Silvana Estrada
evening.location: DPAC, 123 Vivian St / William V. "Bill" Bell Way, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: DPAC is a 3-minute walk from the ATC lawn. Ticket price not shown on the listing.

food.notes: 776 9th St, Durham NC 27705 (~1.5 mi from Durham Central Park; nothing closer verified open at 7:30 AM Sat). Own site: Sat-Sun 7:00am-3:30pm. Vegetarian Hash ($9.25) is listed under weekend brunch. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen. Alternative after 8 AM: Ninth Street Bakery, 136 E Chapel Hill St (own site: Sat 8am-5pm, mostly vegan breads/bakes, no prices).

112 W Main St, Durham NC 27701 (downtown, ~0.4 mi to American Tobacco Campus). Own site /hours: open seven days 11am-9pm. Menu PDF (Spring 2026) marks Chili Braised Jack Fruit 'GF, V+' ($16, rotisserie plate with two sides) and Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower 'V' ($11). Legend: V vegetarian, V+ vegan.

335 W Main St, Durham NC 27701 (~0.5 mi to DPAC). Own site: Fri-Sat 5-10:30pm, so 5:30 PM works. Dinner menu (image) marks Gobi Sukka $12 '(GFr, V)' and Achari Paneer $22 '(Veg)'; legend: (V) Vegan, (Veg) Vegetarian. Reservations page on site.

alternatives.good_weather: Forecast is mostly cloudy, about 72°F — walk the market and the craft rows.
alternatives.rain: The farmers market pavilion is covered; the craft market is open-air, so keep the visit short and head to lunch early.

alternatives.good_weather: Bring a blanket for the ATC lawn.
alternatives.rain: The lawn show is outdoors; if it rains, wait it out in the ATC restaurants before the DPAC show.

practical_notes: Park once near the American Tobacco Campus; the matinee lawn and DPAC are a short walk apart.
Durham Central Park to ATC is about a 15-minute walk or a 5-minute drive.
Good Moon festival weekend means heavy downtown traffic after 6 PM; arrive by 6:30 PM for the 7 PM DPAC show.
Booking: Sylvan Esso via the DPAC/Ticketmaster link on the event; matinee RSVP via Eventbrite.

itineraries.title: Raleigh Festival Saturday: North Hills to Five Points to the Symphony
itineraries.theme: Farmers market, two free neighborhood festivals, and an evening NC Symphony concert
itineraries.drive_time: All within Raleigh; about 10 minutes' drive between stops
itineraries.cost_range: Free daytime; NC Symphony from $30 plus about $40–$70 for meals
itineraries.overview: A Raleigh-neighborhoods day. Shop the Midtown Farmers Market at North Hills, spend late morning at the Fall for Five Points Festival, stop by PoeFest, and finish with the NC Symphony playing Mendelssohn at Meymandi Concert Hall.

morning.title: Midtown Farmers Market
morning.location: The Commons at North Hills, 4191 Main at North Hills Street, Raleigh, NC 27609
morning.notes: Saturday market at The Commons, North Hills, 8 AM–noon.

morning.title: Fall for Five Points Festival
morning.location: Five Points, 2000 Fairview Road, Raleigh, NC
morning.notes: Free neighborhood festival in Five Points, 11 AM–6 PM.

afternoon.title: PoeFest Community Festival
afternoon.location: Poe Center, 224 Sunnybrook Road, Raleigh, NC 27604
afternoon.notes: Free community festival at the Poe Center, 1–4 PM; about 10 minutes from Five Points.

evening.title: NC Symphony: Mendelssohn Violin Concerto
evening.location: Meymandi Concert Hall, 2 East South Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 8 PM at Meymandi Concert Hall, Martin Marietta Center.

food.notes: 160 Park at North Hills St, Suite 127, Raleigh NC 27609. Own location page: Sat-Sun 7:00am-3:00pm. Veggie Delight Omelette (goat cheese, spinach, tomatoes, mushrooms) is vegetarian by listed ingredients; menu has no dietary labels and shows no base prices. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

1813 Glenwood Ave, Raleigh NC 27608 (Five Points). Own site: Sat 11am-2:30pm, 4:30-10pm. Gaia's Revenge (olive oil, garlic, Atomic Tofu, broccoli, banana peppers, Daiya vegan cheese) is flagged vegan-option/vegetarian, $16.80 for 10-inch; ask for vegan crust. Sergeant Scofflaw (olive oil, garlic, tomato, fresh mozzarella, parmesan, basil) $15.68 for 10-inch. Size mapping of prices is inferred from page order.

222 S Blount St, Raleigh NC 27601 (~0.5 mi from Martin Marietta Center). Own site: Mon-Sat 5-10pm; reserve ahead. Dad's Simple Fried Rice $23.90 with vegetable option marked '(vegan)'; Manda Amphone's Curry $25.90 with pumpkin option marked '(GF/V)' (V = vegetarian per menu legend).

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly cloudy, about 72°F — good festival weather.
alternatives.rain: Swap the outdoor festivals for the NC Museum of Art or NC Museum of Natural Sciences (both free) before dinner.

practical_notes: NC State hosts Wake Forest at Carter-Finley Stadium at noon — expect traffic on Blue Ridge Rd and Wade Ave around game time.
Allow time to park downtown for the symphony; arrive by 7:30 PM.
Booking: symphony tickets via the Ticketmaster link on the event.

itineraries.title: Western Wake: Hum Sub Diwali and Apex Oktoberfest
itineraries.theme: Cary farmers market, the free Hum Sub Diwali festival at Koka Booth, Apex Oktoberfest, and a community play at the Halle
itineraries.drive_time: About 20 min from Raleigh to downtown Cary; Koka Booth to downtown Apex is about 15 min
itineraries.cost_range: Free festivals; Diwali parking is listed at $10; Halle play $12–$18; meals about $40–$70
itineraries.overview: Two big free festivals in western Wake. Start at the Cary Farmers Market, spend the late morning at Hum Sub Diwali at Koka Booth Amphitheatre, drive to downtown Apex for Oktoberfest, and end with the Halle's fall play.

morning.title: Cary Farmers Market
morning.location: Downtown Cary Park – East Park Street, 327 S. Academy St., Cary, NC 27511
morning.notes: Saturday market in Downtown Cary Park, 8 AM–noon.

morning.title: Hum Sub Diwali
morning.location: Koka Booth Amphitheatre, 8003 Regency Parkway, Cary, NC 27518
morning.notes: Free admission (the listing notes paid parking); runs 9 AM–9:30 PM.

afternoon.title: Apex Oktoberfest
afternoon.location: Town of Apex; Apex Town Campus, 73 Hunter St., Apex, NC 27502
afternoon.notes: Free street festival on the Apex town campus, 11 AM–7 PM.

evening.title: "Drinking Habits" Fall Play
evening.location: The Halle Cultural Arts Center, 237 N. Salem St., Apex, NC 27502
evening.notes: Community fall play at the Halle Cultural Arts Center, 7:30 PM.

food.notes: 220 W Chatham St, Cary NC 27511 (~0.3 mi from 327 S Academy St). Bakery opens 7am (Fri-Sat 7am-6pm inferred from hours block on own site — confirm 919-650-3117); plated breakfast menu is served 8-11am, so at 7:30 expect pastries/coffee, hot plates from 8. Tomato Cheddar Scramble is vegetarian by ingredients (also Spinach Feta Quiche). No prices on menu page. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

100 N Salem St, Apex NC 27502. Own site: Sat 11:00am-9:00pm. Margherita 12" $14.25 (crushed Roma tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, Romano, basil); Vegetable Pizza also available ($5.51/slice). No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen (Sauteed Broccoli or Spinach $6.78 and Garden Salad $8.65 are plant-based by listed ingredients but not labeled).

201 W Chatham St, Suite 103, Cary NC 27511 (downtown Cary). Own site confirms address and says the menu includes vegetarian and vegan-friendly dishes (samosas, hummus, pakoras, vegetable curries) but no item names/prices could be read (online ordering page not parseable). Saturday hours only from third-party listings (VisitRaleigh: Sat noon-10pm) — call 919-377-8794. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen. Weakest slot; consider replacing.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly cloudy, about 72°F — both festivals are outdoors.
alternatives.rain: Both are outdoor; if it rains, spend the afternoon at the Halle or the Cary Arts Center galleries and come back for the evening.

practical_notes: Koka Booth is at 8003 Regency Pkwy, Cary; check humsub.org for parking and shuttle details before you go.
Expect crowded parking in downtown Apex during Oktoberfest; arrive early.
Booking: the Halle play via thehalle.org.

itineraries.title: Hillsborough Saturday: History Walk, FlushFest and Bluegrass at Moorefields
itineraries.theme: Guided historic walking tour, a potters' sale, homemade-music festival and an afternoon bluegrass festival
itineraries.drive_time: About 40 min west of Raleigh via I-40/I-85; 20 min from Durham
itineraries.cost_range: About $25–$45 per person for the tour and bluegrass tickets, plus meals
itineraries.overview: A small-town Saturday in Hillsborough. Take the guided historic tour from the Visitors Center, browse the ClayWorks potters' sale, catch FlushFest at Eno River Brewing, then drive out to Historic Moorefields for the bluegrass festival.

morning.title: Historic Hillsborough Guided Tours 2026
morning.location: Hillsborough Visitors Center, 150 E King Street, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: Guided walking tour from the Visitors Center, 10:30 AM, $10.

morning.title: ClayWorks Potters Guild Sale
morning.location: Eno Arts Mill Gallery, 437 Dimmocks Mill Road, Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: Free potters' guild sale at Eno Arts Mill, 11 AM–5 PM.

afternoon.title: FlushFest -- Hillsborough's Homemade Music Festival (admission by donation)
afternoon.location: Eno River Brewing, 329 Allison Street, Hillsborough, NC
afternoon.notes: Free homemade-music festival at Eno River Brewing from noon.

afternoon.title: 2026 Bluegrass Festival
afternoon.notes: Bluegrass festival at Historic Moorefields, 1–6 PM.

food.notes: 228 S Churton St, Hillsborough NC 27278. Own site: open daily 7am-9pm; co-op grocery with cafe/food bar. No specific breakfast dishes listed on its site. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

228 S Churton St, Hillsborough NC 27278. Own site: open daily 7am-9pm; food bar specials rotate weekly and none are named on the page. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen. Could not verify a sit-down downtown Hillsborough lunch spot with an own-site menu in the time budget (Saratoga Grill lunch hours only from a ~2020 review).

120-122 W King St, Hillsborough NC 27278 (historic Osbunn Theater). THIRD-PARTY ONLY: no own website found. Hours from HappyCow/Spinach listings: Sat 4-10pm, closed Sun. Dishes/prices from Toast listing snippets (Paneer Masala $22, Red Thai Cauliflower $12); vegan labeling of Thai cauliflower comes from Spinach/HappyCow ('vegan options labeled on menu'), menu rotates ~every two months. Call 984-217-0179.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly cloudy, about 72°F — good for walking and an outdoor festival.
alternatives.rain: Stay downtown: the potters' sale is indoors and FlushFest uses the brewery taproom.

practical_notes: Park downtown for the tour and FlushFest; drive to Moorefields (2201 Moorefields Rd) for the bluegrass festival.
Booking: walking tour via the Zeffy link on the event; bluegrass tickets via Eventbrite.

itineraries.title: Rainy-Day Raleigh Sunday: Art Museum, Greenway History and beabadoobee
itineraries.theme: Museums and a downtown history walk on a stormy Sunday, then beabadoobee at Lenovo Center
itineraries.drive_time: All within Raleigh; NCMA and Lenovo Center are 5 minutes apart
itineraries.cost_range: Free museums; walking tour $15; beabadoobee from $65; meals about $40–$70
itineraries.overview: Showers and thunderstorms are forecast all day Sunday, so this plan leans indoors. See the Raleigh greenway exhibit at the City of Raleigh Museum, take the downtown history tour if the rain lets up, spend the afternoon at the NC Museum of Art, and end with beabadoobee at Lenovo Center.

morning.title: The Park with a City in It: 50 Years of the Raleigh Greenway System
morning.location: City of Raleigh Museum, 220 Fayetteville Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
morning.notes: Free exhibit on 50 years of Raleigh's greenways at the City of Raleigh Museum.

afternoon.title: Public Tour
afternoon.location: NC Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh, NC 27607

afternoon.title: Art on the Dot
afternoon.location: NC Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh, NC 27607

evening.title: beabadoobee
evening.location: Lenovo Center, 1400 Edwards Mill Rd., Raleigh, NC 27607
evening.notes: 8 PM at Lenovo Center; listed from $65.

food.notes: 200 Park at North Hills St, Suite 101, Raleigh NC 27609. Own locations page: open 8am-8pm every day. Açaí Bowl is labeled (V) vegetarian; no item is labeled (VG) vegan, though tofu is a build-your-own protein. No prices on menu page. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen. Stronger vegan option if 10 AM works: True Food Kitchen, 4104 Center at North Hills St (weekend brunch from 10am per own location page via search; menu is JS-rendered and could not be verified).

MOVED: now 2431-103 Crabtree Blvd, Raleigh (no longer 428 S Dawson St) — ~3 mi from Person St, not downtown. Own site: Sun 11:30am-2:30pm. Fully vegan restaurant ('Vegetarian & Vegan Cuisine'), so every dish is vegan. Dishes are from the Brunch menu (Grit Bowl $17.50, French Toast $14.50); the site does not say which midday menu runs Sunday, so lunch-menu items (e.g., Tofu Banh Mi $16) may apply instead.

901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603 (~1 mi from Cameron Village; ~4 mi / ~10 min via Wade Ave to Lenovo Center — eat promptly to make an 8 PM show). Own site: Sun dinner 4:30-9pm. Dinner menu: Mujaddara 'VG' $19, Eggplant Tower 'VEG, GF' $17 (legend VEG vegetarian, VG vegan). Label-to-item mapping came from a scraped page and may be slightly off — confirm with server.

alternatives.good_weather: If the storms clear, take the Downtown Raleigh Historic Walking Tour at 2 PM ($15) instead of the NCMA tour.
alternatives.rain: Showers and thunderstorms are forecast; stay with the museum plan.

alternatives.good_weather: If dry, walk the NCMA Museum Park trails between the tour and Art on the Dot.
alternatives.rain: Stay inside the West Building galleries.

practical_notes: Check the Lenovo Center event page for parking and bag rules; arrive by 7:15 PM.
The Raleigh City Farm Harvest Dinner (4:30 PM, outdoors) is another evening option, but it is weather-dependent this week.
Booking: beabadoobee via the Lenovo Center event page.

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill Tuesday: Farmers Market, Book Launch and Renée Fleming
itineraries.theme: Afternoon farmers market, an author event at Flyleaf, then Renée Fleming at Memorial Hall
itineraries.drive_time: About 35 min west of Raleigh via I-40; 15 min from Durham
itineraries.cost_range: Renée Fleming $49–$134 ($11 students) plus about $30–$60 for meals
itineraries.overview: A sunny weeknight in Chapel Hill. Shop the Tuesday farmers market at University Place, catch a book launch at Flyleaf Books, and see Renée Fleming's 'Voice of Nature: The Anthropocene' recital at Memorial Hall.

afternoon.title: Chapel Hill Farmers' Market
afternoon.location: University Place, 201 S. Estes Drive, Chapel Hill, NC
afternoon.notes: Tuesday market at University Place, 3–6 PM.

evening.title: Kate Hash launches THE MOTHER-IN-LAW BOOK CLUB, with Eleanor Goymer
evening.location: Flyleaf Books, 752 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
evening.notes: Free book launch at Flyleaf Books, 5:30 PM.

evening.title: Renée Fleming in Recital | Voice of Nature: The Anthropocene
evening.location: Memorial Hall, 114 East Cameron Ave , Chapel Hill, NC 27514

food.notes: 410 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill NC 27516. Own site: open daily 11am-9pm. Menu image has no prices and no dietary labels. Veggie Gyro = hummus, mixed vegetables, tabouli, feta (vegetarian by ingredients). Build Your Own Falafel Pita (falafel, hummus/baba/tabouli fillings, tahini) appears plant-based by ingredients but is not labeled. No vegan dish verified on the restaurant's own menu — ask the kitchen.

MOVED: now 1800 E Franklin St #16, Chapel Hill NC 27514 (Eastgate Crossing), ~2 mi east of downtown Franklin St. Own site: Tue dinner 5-9pm. Dinner menu PDF (03.13.26): Fasolakia (green beans, tomato, onion, parsley) $10 and Briam (roasted zucchini, tomatoes, eggplant, potatoes, carrots) SM $10 / LG $16, both in the 'Plant-based' section; the menus page text labels Fasolakia vegan and Briam vegetarian. Lemon Linguine $20 is also meatless. Vimala's Curryblossom (431 W Franklin) was the preferred pick but its site (curryblossom.com) would not load.

alternatives.rain: Skip the market and browse Flyleaf Books before the launch.

practical_notes: Memorial Hall is on UNC's campus near Franklin St; check Carolina Performing Arts' parking guidance before you go.
Allow 15 minutes from Flyleaf (MLK Jr Blvd) to Memorial Hall.
Booking: Carolina Performing Arts ticket link on the event.

itineraries.title: State Fair Opening Day and Carolina Ballet's Dracula
itineraries.theme: Opening day at the N.C. State Fair, then the Carolina Ballet's Dracula downtown
itineraries.drive_time: Fairgrounds are about 15 min west of downtown Raleigh; allow 30+ min on opening day
itineraries.cost_range: Fair admission $5–$10 (College Day $8 with student ID per the listing); Dracula $20–$150; meals about $30–$60 plus fair food
itineraries.overview: The N.C. State Fair opens at noon on Thursday. Spend the afternoon at the fairgrounds, then head downtown for Carolina Ballet's Dracula at the Martin Marietta Center.

afternoon.title: N.C. State Fair 2026 Opening Day (College Day)
afternoon.location: N.C. State Fairgrounds, 4285 Trinity Rd, Raleigh, NC 27607
afternoon.notes: Gates open at noon on opening day; advance-price admission per the fair's page.

evening.title: Carolina Ballet: Dracula
evening.location: A.J. Fletcher Opera Theater, 2 East South Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 7:30 PM at the Martin Marietta Center. The venue's calendar lists A.J. Fletcher Opera Theater and the ballet's site lists Raleigh Memorial Auditorium — check your ticket for the hall.

food.notes: 3801 Hillsborough St, Raleigh NC 27607 (beside NC State, ~1.5 mi from the Fairgrounds). Own site (luckytreeraleigh.com): Mon-Thu 7am-6pm, but it has no food menu. THIRD-PARTY MENU (DoorDash/order.online via search): Oatmeal $4.20 (chia, coconut oil, dried cranberries/blueberries, sunflower seeds, brown sugar) is plant-based by ingredients but not labeled vegan; Tomato Basil Bites $6.00 (rice/oat/almond-flour mini biscuits, tomato, mozzarella, marinara). Cafe, not a full breakfast restaurant.

421 Fayetteville St, Suite 103 (City Plaza), Raleigh NC 27601 (~0.2 mi from Martin Marietta Center). Own site: Mon-Thu 11am-9pm. Restaurant describes its food as '100% plant-based comfort food' (header: 'Vegan Restaurant & Bar'), so all items are vegan; any 'cheese' is plant-based. Carolina BBQ $13 (Redefine pulled 'pork', eastern-style sauce, slaw); Elemental Burger $13.50.

alternatives.good_weather: Oct 15 is beyond the NWS 7-day forecast window at run time — check the forecast the day before.
alternatives.rain: If it rains, spend more time in the fair's indoor exhibit halls, or skip the fair and visit the NC Museum of Natural Sciences before the ballet.

practical_notes: Buy fair tickets in advance via the Etix link on the event; opening-day traffic on Blue Ridge Rd and Hillsborough St is heavy.
Leave the fairgrounds by about 5:30 PM to eat and park downtown before the 7:30 PM curtain.
